title: still present since round 4: vacancy/status mutations return Ok unconditionally — nonexistent ids report success
evidence: demo_store.gleam:1245: `#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(vacancy_id))` (archive_vacancy) ; :1259: `#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(vacancy_id))` (restore_vacancy) ; :1273: `#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(vacancy_id))` (close_vacancy) ; :1354: `#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(slug))` (change_status) — no find check, unlike update_vacancy/publish_vacancy which use `find_vacancy(next, vacancy_id) |> result.map(...)` (:1231, :1223)
detail: Error channel is dead for these four mutations; the demo UI reports success for ids that don't exist, diverging from the mirrored real-api error shape.
recommended_fix: list.find the vacancy/application first and propagate Error like update_vacancy/publish_vacancy do.

title: still present since round 4: mark_opened doc claims idempotent Submitted->UnderReview but applies to any status
evidence:
demo_store.gleam:1276-1278: `/// POST /open - idempotently moves a Submitted application to UnderReview
/// and returns the post-transition status slug.
pub fn mark_opened(` ; :1279-1289: `change_status(
    store,
    vacancy_id,
    application_id,
    "under_review",
    "status_auto_changed",
  )` — change_status sets the target unconditionally and appends an audit entry on every call (no current-status guard)
detail: Doc/behaviour mismatch: a viewed/rejected/approved demo application can be 'opened' again, appending a duplicate audit entry each time.
recommended_fix: Guard on current status == Submitted inside mark_opened (no-op otherwise), or correct the doc.

title: still present since round 4: create_vacancy derives ids from an 8-char slug with no uniqueness check
detail: The comment's collision claim is untrue: the second same-named create is appended but find_vacancy (list.find) always resolves the first — the new vacancy is invisible.
recommended_fix: Check the derived id against the store and append a counter suffix on collision.

title: still present since round 4: send_reminder / remind_applicant / send_bulk_invite mutate nothing and return canned counts
detail: Reminders never persist (awaiting list unchanged); canned counts contradict the live fixture awaiting pool, so the demo surfaces lie after the click.
recommended_fix: Derive counts from the awaiting pool and thread the mutated store back into the model.

title: still present since round 4: demo dispatch arms remain unpinned — refcheck trio, single mark-read, report download, edit deep-link get_for_edit, mark-opened threading (awaiting/comparison/scoring/load-more arms did get pins)
evidence: demo_update.gleam:447: `UserClickedDownloadReport(id) ->` ; :481: `UserChoseRefcheckAction(call_id, action) -> {` ; :490: `UserConfirmedRefcheckAction(call_id) -> {` ; :501: `UserSavedRefcheckEdit(call_id) ->` ; :551: `UserClickedNotification(id, _entity_type, _entity_id) -> {` ; grep of client/test/ for these constructors returns matches only in client_test.gleam (non-demo models, e.g. :6402 `let m = refcheck_detail_model([refcheck_call("rc-1", reference_call.Queued)])`) and none in client/test/demo/ — the only refcheck demo coverage is store-level (demo_flow_test.gleam:472 `demo_store.refcheck_action(store, ...)`)
detail: Reverting any of these arms' store threading or response mapping stays green — the r3-W2/r4 pattern pin is still missing for them.
recommended_fix: Drive each arm through client.update from a demo model (the demo_mark_all_read pattern), one pin per arm.

title: still present since round 4: status_from_slug silently coerces unknown slugs to Submitted
detail: A typo'd slug (or a future new server status) silently resets a demo application to Submitted instead of failing loudly.
recommended_fix: Return Result and propagate an Error for unknown slugs (callers already have an error channel).

title: still present since round 4: fetch_leaderboard_page ignores its page parameter
detail: Load-more in demo always re-delivers page 1's slice; the signature promises pagination the store never performs.
recommended_fix: Slice the derived leaderboard by page (and set has_more honestly), or document the single-page demo behaviour at the call site.

title: still present since round 4: store_of's None fallback re-seeds on every call without writing back to the model
detail: If demo_store is ever None while demo_mode is True, each store_of call re-seeds a fresh store — mutations from one call are silently lost by the next.
recommended_fix: Have arms that consumed the fallback write the seeded store back into the model (or assert the invariant instead of silently reseeding).

title: still present since round 4: demo_not_in_demo_toast diverges from add_toast's id convention — ids can collide
evidence: demo_update.gleam:645: `let toast_id = model.next_toast_id + 1` ; :652: `next_toast_id: toast_id,` — versus add_toast (client.gleam:7148): `let id = model.next_toast_id` and :7160: `next_toast_id: id + 1`. With next_toast_id = 5 the demo toast takes 6 and leaves next_toast_id = 6; the next add_toast also takes 6
detail: Two live toasts can share an id — AppDismissToast filters by id, so dismissing one dismisses both.
recommended_fix: Use add_toast's convention: id = model.next_toast_id, next_toast_id = id + 1 (or reuse add_toast itself).

title: still present since round 4: zero-caller export shipped (demo_store.notifications)
evidence: demo_store.gleam:1532: `pub fn notifications(store: DemoStore) -> List(Notification) {` — repo-wide grep for `demo_store.notifications(` finds zero call sites (only notifications_unread at :1564 is used, by demo_flow_test.gleam:599)
detail: Unused public export; the unread-aware variant superseded it.
recommended_fix: Delete the function (or make it private if kept for symmetry).

title: still present since round 4: for_edit reports updated_at: vac.created_at and update_vacancy never bumps timestamps
evidence: demo_store.gleam:953 (inside for_edit): `updated_at: vac.created_at,` ; update_vacancy (:1174-1216) rebuilds the Vacancy with every payload field but never sets updated_at — no timestamp handling anywhere in the mutation
detail: The demo edit page always shows the creation date as "last updated" even after in-demo edits — small fidelity lie against the real surface.
recommended_fix: Set updated_at to the demo clock constant on mutation and report it in for_edit.

title: still present since round 4: CI fetch ban exempts the whole demo_api.gleam file, not just the documented download function
evidence: test.yml:135: `FETCH_VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rln "gleam/fetch" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" | grep -v "demo_api.gleam" || true)` — a file-level -v exemption; demo_api.gleam's only fetch use is download (:421-424 `use fetch_result <- promise.try_await(fetch.send(req))`), but any future fetch added anywhere else in the file passes CI
detail: The no-network grep's exemption is broader than the one documented static-PDF fetch — a second fetch call site in demo_api would pass silently.
recommended_fix: Narrow the exemption (e.g. permit gleam/fetch only within the download fn's line range) or add a bite-test for a second fetch site.
